document.abstract: This presentation details several new technologies to support 4K acquisition as it becomes the norm in high-end cinema production applications. Technical details will be given on a novel 8K camera sensor, a high-speed digital memory architecture with associated storage and processing devices, a very high-quality compression codec and a RAW file-based Digital Intermediate workflow for motion picture and episodic TV productions.
